svg.title: Who builds, who tests, who approves
svg.desc: The operating model: build and run, test and protect, approve and oversee are separate functions, with their roles; the AI Governance Council decides where they disagree; Internal Audit gives independent assurance.
svg.text: WHO BUILDS, WHO TESTS, WHO APPROVES
Three separate functions, the three pillars Adopt · Defend · Govern. Each has its own question, its own people and its own output.
Purpose, use and risk; the assessments; asks for approvals
